description: Boiarka dacha streets 21-ша ... 40-ва Лінія: the number of the street name is its only distinct word; 33-я (one letter) was not indexed and every Лінія street looked the same. The extract keeps the real 'Liniia A Street' (way 368590725) so that 'a' is a common word as on the full Kyiv map: otherwise '28-a liniia street' counts 'a' as an unmatched word and the regression does not reproduce
